name: @devdogsuga/deploy-checks
description: Read-only post-deploy verification: the config-reconcile gate deploy.yaml's migrate jobs run, and the production/staging smoke test deploy-app.yaml runs after each Worker deploy (public routes load, the auth redirect works, reconcile succeeded, Sentry is reachable when configured). No workspace package imports this at build time -- it exists to be invoked as a script from the deploy workflow, the same way packages/repo-checks exists to be invoked from ci.yaml.
